◆ TARGET COMPUTATION · Structural, not ATR · AVGO SWING (sample)

①The Question — if T1/T2 are computed by ATR alone, why do they so often miss real reaction zones?

ATR-only targets are arbitrary. "T1 = entry + 2× ATR" puts the target wherever recent volatility says, not where actual supply sits.
Structural targets are anchored. T1/T2 are picked from real levels where prior orders, prior pivots, or volume actually traded. ATR becomes a sanity guardrail — not the source.

CConfluence Stacking — a level with 3 stacked sources >> a level with 1

The rule: for each R-multiple band (≥1.5R for T1, ≥3R for T2), pick the candidate with the highest confluence score — not the nearest, not the furthest. Confluence weights priorities the level that has the most structural reasons to act as resistance.

$230 +3.0R Fib 1.618 only (0.5) 0.5 conf < $223
Note on T2 R-floor for SWING: standard is ≥3R, but SWING's tight window (≤10d) often can't reach 3R structurally. We bend to ≥2R when (a) confluence ≥ 5.0, AND (b) the next-higher level has dramatically lower confluence. Here $230 (Fib only, conf 0.5) loses to $223 (conf 6.0) — T2 = $223 at 2.3R is the honest target.

EMode Differences — same candidate pool · different selection rules per strategy

FMagnet vs Rejection classification — targets aren't all the same · how price behaves at each drives the scale-out plan

★ MAGNET

Sources: HVN center · POC · max-pain · heavily-traded round number
Behavior: price pulls here · often blasts through on first touch
Scale-out: hold full size to target · don't trim early

⮜ REJECTION

Sources: VAH (first touch) · opposing FVG · AVWAP 52w-high · swing-high after BOS
Behavior: price fades on first touch · re-test then resolve
Scale-out: sell 50% on touch · save remainder for second push

↑↓ MIXED · liquidity sweep

Sources: equal-highs above prior pivot (BSL pool)
Behavior: sweep above, then either continuation OR reversal
Scale-out: trim 33% on touch · wait one bar for resolution · close remainder on signal

⟁ STRUCTURAL · invest only

Sources: IV_central · IV_high · analyst PT consensus
Behavior: long-cycle convergence · not single-touch
Scale-out: trim 33% / 33% at IV_central / IV_high · final 33% trails on 200d-SMA
